summary: Implemented the show_speed feature without running any tests, mypy, or black, since those were ruled out. Edits: rich/progress.py (TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed, a static render_speed, a render branch for unknown totals, and a class docstring with Args; module track() gains show_speed=True and passes it to the column, with its docstring entry; Progress.track declares an Optional total and no longer raises for unsized iterables). tests/test_progress.py: added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError blocks. CHANGELOG.md: one Unreleased/Added line. Nothing was committed. Left the default columns in Progress (around line 1120) unchanged, since the spec covers only the module-level track() helper. Verification is by reading only; the tests and the strict mypy and black checks still need to be run in CI or locally.
